abi.arm64_long_double: 16 bytes,113 mantissa bits; checked by target compiler assertion
abi.handles: Runtime-owned opaque registry entries; guest handles never passed to host libc
abi.thread_selection: Host TLS reached after native import bridge restores host TP; each guest worker retains an independent selection

behavior.empty_name: C.UTF-8; does not read host environment
behavior.newlocale_base: API26 Bionic returns a distinct whole-locale object and ignores base/category selection after mask validation; valid base remains caller-owned. Mixed-category POSIX locales are not claimed.
behavior.invalid_masks_names: EINVAL for invalid mask/null name; ENOENT for unavailable locale name
behavior.ownership: duplocale snapshots state; uselocale query/swap preserves previous selection; invalid handles safely reject; freeing an active handle rejects with EBUSY instead of exposing freed host memory
behavior.thread_cleanup: Actual native/GL worker exit releases selection after C++/pthread destructors; main selection survives global DSO destructors until post-quiescence native_reset
behavior.storage_cleanup: Locale handles freed before generic guest allocation reset; private host locale objects freed only after worker quiescence
behavior.numeric_and_collation: C decimal point, numeric parser/end-pointer/overflow semantics and identity collation; explicit private host C locale prevents ambient locale from selecting number syntax
behavior.wide_classification: Uses real private host UTF-8 tables for Android wide-character functions; exact ICU binary-property and Unicode-version equivalence not established
behavior.time: Converts Android tm layout; uses explicit guest offset/zone for %z/%Z, including percent escaping; no host timezone substitution for those fields
behavior.time_resource_limits: Format <=65536 bytes; zone <=255 bytes; offset magnitude<86400 seconds; two-pass exact-size fallible temporary allocation
behavior.unavailable_time_extension: %s returns0/ENOTSUP; not fabricated using host timezone
